title: Snake
description: The classic snake game, freshly made for your browser. Guide the hungry snake to eat apples and grow longer — but don't bump into the walls or your own tail! The snake speeds up as your score climbs.
instructions: Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer the snake.
On a phone or tablet, swipe on the board or use the on-screen arrow pad.
Eat the red apples to grow and score points.
Avoid the walls and your own tail.
Press P to pause and Space to start again.
